sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "players" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(display_name) <> ''), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(name) <> ''), "scheduled_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN ('casual', 'formal')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('upcoming', 'registration', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'archived')), "entry_fee_minor_units" INTEGER NULL, "entry_fee_currency" TEXT NULL, "court_label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(court_label) <> ''), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((entry_fee_minor_units IS NULL AND entry_fee_currency IS NULL) OR (entry_fee_minor_units >= 0 AND entry_fee_currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]')), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_divisions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(name) <> ''), "tournament_format" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tournament_format IN ('singleElimination', 'doubleElimination', 'singleRoundRobin', 'doubleRoundRobin')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_participants" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "player_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "check_in_status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (check_in_status IN ('notPresent', 'checkedIn')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "division_participants" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "event_participant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_participants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "participant_payments" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_participant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_participants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "division_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('unpaid', 'paid')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teams" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "formation_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (formation_method IN ('manual', 'random', 'balanced')), "display_label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (display_label IS NULL OR trim(display_label) <> ''), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_members" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "player_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("team_id", "player_id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "matches" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "side_one_team_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "side_two_team_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'queued', 'inProgress', 'completed')), "side_one_score" INTEGER NULL, "side_two_score" INTEGER NULL, "winner_team_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "round_number" INTEGER NULL, "sequence_number" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (side_one_team_id IS NULL OR side_two_team_id IS NULL OR side_one_team_id <> side_two_team_id), CHECK (side_one_score IS NULL OR side_one_score >= 0), CHECK (side_two_score IS NULL OR side_two_score >= 0), CHECK (round_number IS NULL OR round_number > 0), CHECK (sequence_number IS NULL OR sequence_number > 0), CHECK ((status = 'completed' AND side_one_team_id IS NOT NULL AND side_two_team_id IS NOT NULL AND side_one_score IS NOT NULL AND side_two_score IS NOT NULL AND winner_team_id IS NOT NULL AND winner_team_id IN (side_one_team_id, side_two_team_id)) OR (status <> 'completed' AND winner_team_id IS NULL)), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_dependencies" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "source_match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_outcome" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_outcome IN ('winner', 'loser')), "destination_match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "destination_slot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (destination_slot IN ('sideOne', 'sideTwo')), PRIMARY KEY ("source_match_id", "source_outcome", "destination_match_id", "destination_slot"), CHECK (source_match_id <> destination_match_id), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "court_queue_entries" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "division_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "queue_position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (queue_position >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "division_placements" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type = 'player'), "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "operation_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation_kind IN ('upsert', 'tombstone')), "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND json_type(payload_json) = 'object'), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_eligible_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'inFlight', 'conflicted', 'failed')), "claimed_at" TEXT NULL, "failure_code" TEXT NULL, "failure_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (base_version IS NULL OR base_version >= 0), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), CHECK ((status = 'inFlight' AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'inFlight' AND claimed_at IS NULL)), CHECK (failure_message IS NULL OR length(failure_message) <= 240));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_pull_checkpoints" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type = 'player'), "cursor_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sync_outbox_operations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type = 'player'), "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "expected_version" INTEGER NULL, "local_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(local_payload_json) AND json_type(local_payload_json) = 'object'), "remote_payload_json" TEXT NULL, "remote_version" INTEGER NULL, "detected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('unresolved', 'resolved')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (expected_version IS NULL OR expected_version >= 0), CHECK (remote_version IS NULL OR remote_version >= 0), CHECK (remote_payload_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(remote_payload_json) AND json_type(remote_payload_json) = 'object')));
